description: Remove a pop-up from a dimmed grid screenshot: undim the screen, then cover the pop-up with a band of grid rows copied from the same screen (rows repeat at a fixed pitch, so the band is taken a whole number of rows above/below and pasted at the pop-up). Fix the cell texts of the rebuilt rows afterwards with change_value / replace_text. Used for: Arrival Notice Add (select record + Add) built from the Add pop-up shot.

inputs.band: x0,y0,x1,y1 of the rows to copy (same x as the pop-up, height >= pop-up height, a whole number of rows away)
inputs.y: band top y at the pop-up (band y0 + n * row pitch)
